Large colour clusters, restrained detail, dark outline on objects, no smooth 3D, no vector gradients, no text/numbers/captions, no page border. TRANSPARENT RGBA background. EXACT grid: FOUR columns, 4 rows with generous empty transparent gutters between every cell. Each row is one object. Columns are the SAME object seen at SE (front+right), NE (back+right), NW (back+left), SW (front+left), 90-degree rotations at fixed 35-degree elevation. Keep ground centre, scale and proportions constant. Bottom faces sit on a square world tile, no big floating diamond slab and no long cast shadow. Distinct front and back, never four repeated fronts.
ROW 1: A tiny group of creek reeds with three broad green leaves and two brown cattail heads, no water tile, no pot.
ROW 2: A compact abandoned stone watchpost ruin: two crumbled grey walls meeting a corner, one broken low tower stump, a little moss; no flags or people.
ROW 3: A small coastal lighthouse: short cream tower, dark teal conical roof, clear amber lantern window and modest stone base, no lighthouse beam or island.
ROW 4: A simple wooden trade-road gate: TWO sturdy wooden posts with one broad beam above, a small plain red hanging sign with a simple gold crate emblem. There must be a wide OPEN roadway between posts, no floor slab and no barrier across the road.

revisions.prompt: Edit ONLY the FIRST ROW of this four-by-four transparent pixel sprite sheet: remove the artificial brown and black diamond foundation tiles under the four reed/cattail plants. Their stalks should root directly on transparent ground, no platform. Preserve all reed artwork, and preserve rows 2, 3 and 4 (ruin, lighthouse, wooden trade gate) entirely unchanged. Same layout, same scale, crisp pixel art.
